audience: short-term rental hosts and managers who price their listings with Beyond Pricing

useCases.title: Review listings and their price syncing
useCases.text: List the listings Beyond prices, with base price and sync state. Open one listing for its minimum and maximum prices and its pricing-readiness flag.

useCases.title: Read the nightly calendar and reservations
useCases.text: Read a listing's nightly prices, availability and pricing factors for a date range. List the reservations of your listings by check-in window or status.

useCases.title: Compare occupancy with the neighborhood
useCases.text: Compare one listing's occupancy and revenue per night with its neighborhood benchmark. Read the comp set of comparable listings.

useCases.title: Explain a price with the rules and history
useCases.text: Read all pricing rules of a listing. See who changed its pricing settings and when, and the base-price recommendations.

useCases.title: Set the base price of a listing
useCases.text: Set the nightly base price of one listing, within the minimum that Beyond allows. This changes live prices on the channels.

useCases.title: Turn price syncing on or off
useCases.text: Turn price syncing on or off for one listing. Turning it on starts live pricing on its channels.
